### Show No Partiality - Truth For Life - December 28
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-december-28-2023.html
Passage: James 2:1
Points:
- Genuine faith is demonstrated not only by what believers do, but also by refusing to show partiality.
- External markers like wealth or status do not make an individual inherently worthy of special honor.
- Showing preferential treatment based on appearance makes believers judges driven by corrupt motives.
- Jesus modeled perfect impartiality by extending grace equally to the rich and the marginalized.
- Christians should reflect God's character by viewing and treating others with impartial mercy.

### The Racism Antidote: Love Like Jesus Does - Daily Hope with Rick Warren - June 14, 2020
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-june-14-2020.html
Passage: James 2:1
Points:
- Prejudice and favoritism contradict the command of Christ to love others as He loved us.
- Scripture forbids treating people differently based on superficial outward appearances or social standing.
- Christlike love is practical, unconditional, and extends across all racial and socioeconomic boundaries.
- Believers must reject harmful stereotypes and respect each person as an individual created by God.

### Exposing the Sin of Partiality - The Crosswalk Devotional - September 9
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/exposing-the-sin-of-partiality-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: James 2:9
Points:
- Scripture classifies partiality as a direct sin rather than an innocent preference.
- Christians often justify favoritism in their giving, service, and prayers based on personal affinity.
- God does not show favoritism and expects believers to avoid bias in homes, churches, and workplaces.
- Believers can overcome partiality by relying on God's guidance and giving generously without bias.

### The Importance of Avoiding Favoritism - The Crosswalk Devotional - September 17
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-importance-of-avoiding-favoritism-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: James 2:1
Points:
- Favoritism causes deep emotional pain and damages relationships, especially within the family.
- Practicing preferential treatment directly opposes God's righteous standard of equal love.
- Overcoming favoritism requires admitting the fault, apologizing to those hurt, and changing behavior.
- Christians can overcome past rejection by resting in God's unconditional love for His children.
